summary: Cardiol Therapeutics filed a Form 6-K on September 10, 2026, announcing a preliminary short form base shelf prospectus in Canada and a corresponding Form F-10 registration statement with the SEC under the U.S./Canada Multijurisdictional Disclosure System, permitting up to US$150 million of securities over 25 months. No securities are being offered now, and the filing does not obligate an offering. The prospectus includes supplemental program and expense disclosure requested by OSC staff, with no restatement or change to reported financials. This is a routine shelf registration, not a special situation.
